static-website.title: Host a static website from Blob Storage
static-website.brief: Turn on static website hosting in a storage account, publish a page, change it, and clean up.

new-employee-access.title: Give a new employee least-privilege access
new-employee-access.brief: Create a user and a group in Microsoft Entra ID, grant the group a role on one resource group, and check it can do no more.

functions-endpoint.title: Serve an endpoint with Azure Functions
functions-endpoint.brief: Create a function app on a consumption plan with an HTTP-triggered function, call it, and read its logs.

tags-and-locks.title: Tag resources and lock them
tags-and-locks.brief: Tag resources for cost tracking, put a delete lock on them, prove the lock stops a deletion, then remove it.

cost-guardrails.title: Set up cost guardrails
cost-guardrails.brief: Tag for cost tracking, create a budget with alerts, and assign a policy that rejects resources breaking a rule.

cloud-shell-cli.title: Manage resources from Cloud Shell
cloud-shell-cli.brief: Create, list, tag and query resources with az commands in Cloud Shell, formatting and filtering the output.

identity-design.title: Identity and least privilege lab
identity-design.brief: Design a narrow identity grant for a blob reader without saving credentials.

compile-bicep.title: Infrastructure as code lab
compile-bicep.brief: Compile a parameterized deployment description locally without creating cloud resources.

repeat-safe-handler.title: Resilient application integration lab
repeat-safe-handler.brief: Write and test a Python handler that ignores repeated operation IDs.

service-responsibility-design.title: Design a service and responsibility handoff
service-responsibility-design.brief: Choose service models for three original workloads and explain which security responsibilities remain with the customer.

scaling-policy-model.title: Check a local scaling-policy model
scaling-policy-model.brief: Work through a bounded scaling-rule worksheet, with an optional Python coding extension; no cloud service is called.
